title: THE MARY CELESTE | Part 1: The Ghost Ship
description:
December 1872. A ship is found drifting in the Atlantic: seaworthy, full of food, cargo untouched, and not a single person on board. Ten people had vanished.

Part 1 of an animated mystery series about the Mary Celeste.

#maryceleste #ghostship #unsolvedmystery #animation #history

shots.say: November, eighteen seventy-two. In New York harbor, a small two-masted ship called the Mary Celeste was getting ready to cross the Atlantic.
shots.caption: NEW YORK, 1872

flow.image: A wide view of New York harbor in November 1872, grey morning, wooden piers, a small two-masted brigantine named Mary Celeste being loaded with barrels, seagulls.
flow.motion: Slow push-in toward the ship, seagulls flying, water gently moving, sailors carrying barrels.

shots.say: Her captain was Benjamin Briggs, an experienced and careful sailor. This time, he brought his wife, Sarah, and their two-year-old daughter, Sophia.

flow.image: On the wooden deck of a small sailing ship in harbor, the captain stands with his wife and their little daughter, smiling, masts and ropes behind them.
flow.motion: The family looks around the ship, the little girl points at a seagull, flags and ropes sway in the breeze, slow camera dolly.

shots.say: With them were seven crewmen. Ten people in all.

flow.image: Sailors working on the deck of a small brigantine, pulling ropes and rolling a barrel, sails being raised.
flow.motion: One sailor pulls a rope hand over hand, the other rolls a barrel, sails flutter, light camera pan.

shots.say: In the hold were one thousand seven hundred and one barrels of industrial alcohol, bound for Genoa, Italy.

flow.image: Inside a dark wooden ship's cargo hold lit by a lantern, rows of stacked wooden barrels of alcohol.
flow.motion: Lantern light flickers and sways, slow push along the rows of barrels, dust floating in the light.

shots.say: On November seventh, the Mary Celeste set sail.

flow.image: A small two-masted brigantine with full white sails leaving harbor at sunset, orange and purple sky, calm sea.
flow.motion: The ship sails slowly across the frame, waves roll, sails fill with wind, sunset light shimmers on the water.

shots.say: Almost a month later, on December fourth, the crew of a British ship, the Dei Gratia, spotted a sail on the horizon. They were between the Azores and Portugal.
Something was wrong. The ship was moving strangely, as if no one was steering. Some sails were set. Others were torn, or missing.

flow.image: Open Atlantic ocean on a bright day, a lone two-masted brigantine in the distance with some sails torn and loose, drifting strangely; a second sailing ship in the foreground.
flow.motion: The distant ship drifts and turns oddly, torn sails flapping, waves rolling, the camera slowly zooms toward it.

shots.say: The Dei Gratia's captain recognized her. It was the Mary Celeste. They signaled. There was no answer.
shots.caption: NO ANSWER.

flow.image: A lonely two-masted sailing ship with torn sails drifting in thick sea fog, no one visible on deck, eerie grey light.
flow.motion: Fog drifts past, the ship rocks slowly on the waves, a torn sail flaps, very slow push-in, eerie mood.

shots.say: Three men rowed across and climbed aboard.

flow.image: Two sailors climbing over the rail onto the wet deck of a foggy abandoned ship, an open cargo hatch, coiled ropes.
flow.motion: The two sailors step onto the deck and look around nervously, fog drifts, the ship creaks and rocks.

shots.say: There was no one on board. Not one single person.
shots.caption: NO ONE.

flow.image: The empty wet deck of an abandoned sailing ship in fog, ship's wheel turning by itself, an open hatch, no people at all.
flow.motion: The wheel slowly turns on its own, ropes sway, fog rolls across the empty deck, slow camera pan.

shots.say: Below deck, everything was damp, but in order. Clothes. Personal belongings. Even the sailors' pipes had been left behind.

flow.image: A damp wooden captain's cabin below deck: a bunk, a table with a logbook, clothes hanging, a child's toy on the floor, a round porthole, a sailor looking around in shock.
flow.motion: The hanging lamp swings, the sailor slowly looks around the cabin, dust in the light, slow push-in.

shots.say: The cargo was almost untouched. And there was enough food and fresh water on board for six months.

flow.image: Ship's storeroom with sacks of food, water casks and barrels, all untouched, lit by soft light through the planks.
flow.motion: Slow camera glide past the supplies, light flickers through the planks, dust floats.

shots.say: There was water below, about three and a half feet of it in the hold. But the ship was not sinking. She was seaworthy.

flow.image: A sailor kneeling by an open cargo hatch on a wet deck, looking down at water sloshing in the dark hold below.
flow.motion: Water sloshes in the hold, the sailor leans in to look, the ship rocks gently.

shots.say: The last entry on the ship's log slate was dated November twenty-fifth, at eight a.m. The ship was passing the island of Santa Maria, in the Azores.

flow.image: Close-up of an old ship's logbook page by lamplight, handwritten entry, a quill pen beside it.
flow.motion: Lamplight flickers, the page edge lifts slightly in a draft, slow push-in onto the handwriting.

shots.say: That meant the Mary Celeste had kept sailing, with no one aboard, for about nine days.
shots.caption: 9 DAYS. ALONE.

shots.say: And then they noticed what was missing. The ship's only lifeboat was gone. So were the captain's navigation instruments, and most of the ship's papers.
shots.caption: THE LIFEBOAT.

flow.image: The stern of a lonely sailing ship in fog, with empty lifeboat davits and cut ropes hanging where the lifeboat used to be.
flow.motion: Cut ropes swing from the empty davits, fog drifts, the ship rocks, slow push-in toward the empty space.
